set.body: Scope: revised PRD Phase 10. Add reusable DecodeConsistency, reconstruction, persistence, binding, interop, single- and multi-acquisition dataset, hierarchy, axis-locality, provenance, publication, registry, and migration-baseline law suites; corrupted, unknown-representation, and interrupted-publication fixtures; compatibility/documentation audit; and removal or deprecation of superseded dispatch. Acceptance: every child epic satisfies its stop and audit gates; Phase-8 import/build guards remain green; focused JVM/JS gates pass; downstream model, fit, MVPA, and group scenarios remain green; every Phase-0 numerical fixture passes under its declared comparator; compileAll and testAll pass warning-clean at the exact committed tip.
